steps.en: Messages are queued to go out later
steps.why_en: Messages are sent at once; nothing is queued for later.
steps.why_id: Pesan dikirim saat itu juga; tidak ada yang dijadwalkan untuk nanti.

steps.en: The notice is updated with the new hirer or driver details
steps.id: Notice diperbarui dengan data hirer atau driver yang baru

steps.en: The new details are copied to the public payment side
steps.id: Data baru disalin ke sisi pembayaran publik
steps.why_en: Copying errors are only logged and address rows are not copied; public display not checked.
steps.why_id: Kesalahan penyalinan hanya dicatat, baris alamat tidak ikut disalin; tampilan publik tidak diperiksa.

steps.en: A message says the details were saved successfully
A message says the sending has been scheduled
steps.why_en: The message says sent, not scheduled, since nothing is scheduled.
steps.why_id: Pesan berbunyi terkirim, bukan terjadwal, karena memang tidak ada penjadwalan.
